name: My log home feels drafty inside — what should I check first before sealing anything?

mainEntity.name: My log home feels drafty inside — what should I check first before sealing anything?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you feel drafts, see gaps between interior logs, or notice dust and odor moving through wall joints, the first step is a detailed interior inspection. Good sealing work focuses on joints, checks, corners, and penetrations so the home can stop leaking air without trapping moisture.
acceptedAnswer.description: Check interior log joints, corners, cracks, and any penetrations for visible gaps or air movement. Start with a careful inspection before sealing so you treat the real leak paths, not just the obvious spots.
